title: Figure 13: SEM of EV damage to palladium target
description: High-contrast black-and-white scanning electron microscope image of a palladium surface densely covered with small ring-shaped craters, with instrument data text along the bottom edge. Caption: "Figure 13. SEM of EV Damage to Palladium Target (Reference 36)." The text above notes at least 100 tiny craters formed from a single EV shot from a 40 pF capacitor charged to 3,000 volts.
